title: 安巴尼在Jio上市仪式动情落泪
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This dream of this dream was born by Isha Diddhi and Akash Bhai made that dream of this dream.
segments.zh: 这个梦想由伊莎·迪迪和阿卡什·拜共同孕育。

segments.en: Jio gave the entire country a blessing.
segments.zh: Jio为整个国家带来了福祉。

segments.en: He said, Jio, my son, Daddy said, Jio, Jio, Jio, Jio, and friends said, Jio, Jio, Jio.
segments.zh: 他说，Jio，我的孩子，爸爸说，Jio，Jio，Jio，Jio，朋友们也说，Jio，Jio，Jio。
